messages:
clare_pm: Kicking off publisher onboarding checklist for AWS/GCP/Azure. Need a compact pack we can hand to partners: artifacts, minimal legal, and publish steps. Quick sync here.

raghav_ops: For artifacts we should provide: image name + checksum, cloud-init or startup script, signed manifest (manifest.sig), and terraform sample. Keep sizes small.

olivia_design: I'll supply hero image + 2 screenshots. Specs: hero 1280x720 jpg, logo 300x300 png. Also alt text and 1-line description (<=120 chars).

priya_legal: Legal needs: one-page EULA (en-US) draft, publisher agreement sign-off, and a short privacy blurb for listing. I can produce templates.

ben_marketplace: Marketplace wants SKU mapping doc (trial vs paid), region coverage, and entitlement flags. Recommend separate SKUs for trial and paid.

clare_pm: Decision: initial launch = no BYOL, single offer per cloud, separate SKUs for trial/paid. OK?

priya_legal: OK. I'll prepare EULA + localized placeholders and a short govcloud addendum note.

raghav_ops: CI/infra needs: service account (redwood-marketplace-ci), least-priv IAM policy, webhook endpoint for publish callbacks, and IP allowlist. Will provide example IAM JSON and pipeline snippet.

ci-bot: repo lint: marketplace-publish passed on branch feature/onboard :white_check_mark:

clare_pm: Action items:
- olivia_design: push assets to shared drive (due Thu)
- priya_legal: draft EULA + gov addendum (due Mon)
- ben_marketplace: SKU mapping + metering notes (due Wed)
- raghav_ops: sample terraform + CI principal request (due Thu)

ben_marketplace: I'll schedule a 30-min publisher kickoff once artifacts are collected.

clare_pm: Thanks team. I'll assemble the compact pack and share with partner PMs.

priya_legal: I'll review the pack before we send.

clare_pm: Meeting invite to follow if needed.
